training_data_disclosure: This detector was fine-tuned (from desklib/ai-text-detector-v1.01, itself a DeBERTa-v3-large detector) over several training cycles on data that includes RAID train-split text: each cycle samples from a pool of 197,877 RAID-train rows (178,261 machine-generated, 19,616 human) drawn across all 11 generators, 8 domains, 12 attack types and the decoding settings, covering 13,371 RAID source documents. No RAID test-split text was used for training, calibration or model selection. Other training data: human text from open corpora and machine text generated by the Desloppy team from current models.
inference_notes: Scores are the model's raw document probability: text split on paragraphs into ~300-word chunks, one probability per chunk (max 512 tokens), word-weighted mean. Same preprocessing as the production service. Run on Kaggle T4 GPUs with the fp32 checkpoint under fp16 autocast; the production service serves an int8 ONNX export of the same checkpoint (mean absolute score difference 0.009 on 150 test texts).
